title: They Can't See It
_designNote: Warm amber accent against a cool blue secondary, and a lighter grain and vignette than sai_ai_interviewer. That video was an investigation and looked like one; this one resolves into relief, so the frame is allowed to be brighter and the grade arc ends warm.
_voiceNote: pace 1.0. Faceless, so the VO is the deliverable. Do not raise pace to fit — cut words instead.
_musicNote: Cheerful bed, deliberately the opposite register to sai_ai_interviewer's drone. Local file from the music library. Window picked by measurement: 30-76s is the flattest stretch (LRA 3.50) and has the lowest 300-3400Hz energy of any window, so it masks the VO least. bedLufs -24 rather than -26 because an upbeat bed is part of the feel here, not just atmosphere.
_sfxNote: maxCount 6 rather than the default 5 because the retention beat takes two cues for one gesture — a riser resolving into a hit. That is five *moments*, which is the top of the range short-form tolerates before effects stop reading as punctuation.
_note: `say` is the spoken text and the alignment key — it must match AVATAR_SCRIPT.md word for word. Beat start/end are NOT authored here; bin/align.mjs derives them from whisper word timestamps and writes assets/beats.json.

beats.say: Nobody out there can see your heart pounding.
beats.caption: THEY CAN'T SEE IT

stock.query: person waiting backstage nervous curtain theatre

beats.say: You feel it inside. They only see outside.
beats.caption: INSIDE vs OUTSIDE
beats._graphicNote: In the versus graphic `left` is always the struck side and `right` is always the side that builds from its steps — position is the contract, `state` is not read. The steps are what the audience actually perceives, which is the whole point of the beat.
